correctness.rationale: Exact normalization follows from N+1 Fourier residue blocks. N blocks have determinant (rs)^j(s²-r²), the alias block contributes rs times its two power difference, and unitary DFT gives (N+1)^(2N+2) in the squared determinant. The scaling, exact angular extremum, rank criterion and strict negative second logarithmic radial derivative cover all integers N≥1. The remaining asymptotic follows from uniformly bounded correction to its N²/2 term. Direct matrix diagnostics agree with the exact formula; they are not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: This is a complete classification in a dimension-matched, naturally rotationally symmetric order-two polyanalytic interpolation model: exact unisolvency for all radii/angles, the global two-orbit determinant optimizer at every polynomial degree, and the sharp N^-1 radial boundary layer. The determinant criterion has a geometric volume interpretation; the result does not claim unrestricted point-set optimality or condition-number optimality.
